mapper.select: select user_id, quota_balance, frozen_quota, used_quota, create_time, update_time from user_quota_account where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.update: update user_quota_account set quota_balance = quota_balance + #{amount}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
update user_quota_account set quota_balance = quota_balance - #{amount}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select user_id, plan_code, plan_name, status, monthly_quota, monthly_used_quota, cycle_start_time, cycle_end_time, create_time, update_time from user_membership_account where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_membership_account ( user_id, plan_code, plan_name, status, monthly_quota, monthly_used_quota, cycle_start_time, cycle_end_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{planCode}, #{planName}, #{status}, #{monthlyQuota}, #{monthlyUsedQuota}, #{cycleStartTime}, #{cycleEndTime}, now(), now() ) on duplicate key update plan_code = values(plan_code), plan_name = values(plan_name), status = values(status), monthly_quota = values(monthly_quota), monthly_used_quota = values(monthly_used_quota), cycle_start_time = values(cycle_start_time), cycle_end_time = values(cycle_end_time), update_time = now()
mapper.update: update user_membership_account set monthly_used_quota = monthly_used_quota + #{amount}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and now() >= cycle_start_time and now() < cycle_end_time and monthly_quota - monthly_used_quota >= #{amount}
mapper.select: select user_id, enabled, base_url, model, text_base_url, text_model, image_base_url, image_model, encrypted_api_key, encrypted_text_api_key, encrypted_image_api_key, key_masked, text_key_masked, image_key_masked, create_time, update_time from user_model_config where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_model_config ( user_id, enabled, base_url, model, text_base_url, text_model, image_base_url, image_model, encrypted_api_key, encrypted_text_api_key, encrypted_image_api_key, key_masked, text_key_masked, image_key_masked, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{enabled}, #{baseUrl}, #{model}, #{textBaseUrl}, #{textModel}, #{imageBaseUrl}, #{imageModel}, #{encryptedApiKey}, #{encryptedTextApiKey}, #{encryptedImageApiKey}, #{keyMasked}, #{textKeyMasked}, #{imageKeyMasked}, now(), now() ) on duplicate key update enabled = values(enabled), base_url = values(base_url), model = values(model), text_base_url = values(text_base_url), text_model = values(text_model), image_base_url = values(image_base_url), image_model = values(image_model), encrypted_api_key = values(encrypted_api_key), encrypted_text_api_key = values(encrypted_text_api_key), encrypted_image_api_key = values(encrypted_image_api_key), key_masked = values(key_masked), text_key_masked = values(text_key_masked), image_key_masked = values(image_key_masked), update_time = now()
